# Product images — live capture 2026-07-30

Captured while diagnosing why 2,920 products across four sources stored no
picture. User-Agent `ScrapeX/0.1 (+contact: owner)`, requests spaced ≥1.2 s,
HTTP 200 throughout, no site objected. **No image file was downloaded** — the
URL is the record. The one exception is a `HEAD` (headers only, no body) used
to settle which host serves masdar's relative `/medias/…` paths.

## What each source publishes

| source | family | census | publishes an image | publishes none |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MADAR | magento-graphql | 761 products | 577 | **184** (placeholder) |
| ALSWEED | salla-html | 1,233 product ids | 15/15 sampled | — |
| ELSEWEDYSHOP | shopify-json | 932 products | **932** | 0 |
| MASDAR | hybris-occ | 640 priced | 560 | **80** |

## MADAR — the 184 are honest blanks, not a gap

`https://www.madar.com/graphql`, `products(filter:{price:{from:"0"}})`,
pageSize 200, 4 pages, asking for `image{url label} media_gallery{url label
position}`.

- 761 products, **all 761** publish an `image` url
- of those, **185 are the shop's placeholder** —
  `…/media/catalog/product/placeholder/default/placeholder_4.png`, one single
  URL shared by all 185
- 577 publish a `media_gallery`; 184 publish none
- **cross-tab: all 184 products with no gallery carry the placeholder as their
  `image`. Products with a real image but no gallery: 0.**

So there is no MADAR product with a picture we fail to store. The connector has
requested and read `image` since `magento.py:130`/`:1246`, and refuses the
placeholder at `:1249` — correctly, because a grey box where a product belongs
is worse than an honest blank.

What the census DID expose: `image.url == media_gallery[0].url` on **575 of the
577** products with a gallery, so the main picture was being filed twice, under
`image` and again under `image_1` (576 products in the warehouse). Fixed by
de-duplicating the URL, not by asking for a new field.

## ELSEWEDYSHOP — `elsewedyshop_products_images_2026-07-30.json`

`https://elsewedyshop.com/products.json?limit=250&page=1..4` — 932 products,
1,032 variants, **1,442 images, every product covered**. Images-per-product:
1×644, 2×153, 3×87, 4×25, 5×11, 6×9, 7×2, 8×1. `alt` is null on all 1,442, and
no variant carries `featured_image`.

Fixture = page 1 trimmed to 2 products, byte-faithful (only the product list
was shortened): the 7-image product (gallery ordering) and a 1-image product.

## MASDAR — `masdar_hybris_occ_images_2026-07-30.json`

`https://api.masdaronline.com/rest/v2/masdar/products/search?fields=FULL&pageSize=100&currentPage=0..13&query=:relevance&lang=ar`
— 1,354 products, 640 priced (the rest publish no price and are skipped by the
connector, as before).

- 560 priced products publish images; **80 publish none**
- every one of the 560 publishes **exactly one PRIMARY picture, three times** —
  `thumbnail` (96Wx96H), `product` (300Wx300H), `zoom` (515Wx515H): 1,680
  entries, 560 distinct pictures
- URLs are **relative** (`/medias/…?context=…`)

Which host serves them (HEAD, headers only):

- `https://api.masdaronline.com/medias/515Wx515H-1000061922-…` → **200
  image/jpeg, 31374 bytes**
- `https://www.masdaronline.com/medias/515Wx515H-1000061922-…` → **404
  text/html**

So relative image paths resolve against the OCC API host, not the storefront
`base_url` — the opposite of `_storefront_url`'s rule for product pages.

Fixture = 3 products. Two imaged ones from page 0; the imageless one
(`1000068754`, priced, `images: []`) was fetched **by code** through the same
search endpoint, because `:relevance` does not order the catalogue identically
between calls and the page-0 slice differs from one request to the next.

## ALSWEED

`https://alsweed.sa/ar/sitemap.xml` → 3 children → 2,466 URLs → 1,233 unique
product ids (the sitemap lists each product once per locale, as
`one_url_per_product` already documents). 15 product pages sampled: **15/15
publish exactly one image in their JSON-LD**, on `cdn.salla.sa`.

No new fixture — `alsweed_product_ldjson.json` already carries the image, and
the connector already reads it. The source manifest was the thing that never
asked for enrichment.
